role: XCUITest of a background → foreground round trip: the app comes back to the foreground on the Record tab it left (not relaunched) and the tab bar still responds. Holds BackgroundForegroundUITests; the app has no widget, and the file name is left over from the removed widget coverage.

units.does: Sets continueAfterFailure=false, creates XCUIApplication, appends launch arguments -UITests-FreshInstall and English locale (UITestLanguage.english), launches the app (the app wipes onboarding/disclaimer/paywall flags, settings files and the session archive via AppLaunchRecovery.resetUITestStateIfRequested) and walks every first-run gate with UITestLaunch.toMainUI, ignoring its Bool result.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test in the class

units.does: Releases the XCUIApplication (app = nil); does not terminate the app.
units.entry: XCTest runner: tearDown after each test in the class

units.does: Opens the Record tab (asserting UITestNav.selectTab succeeded), sends the app to the background and back with UITestLaunch.backgroundToPersist (Home press, wait for background, activate, wait for foreground), then asserts the app is runningForeground, that the Record tab's content (tab.record identifier) is still showing within UITestTiming.s(8) — a crash and relaunch under -UITests-FreshInstall would be back at the first-run gates — and that selecting the Dashboard tab still works.
